days.reasoning:
INHERITANCE. No handoff_out and no A weekend bridge exist for this seam: 0619 (Juneteenth) sits outside G22, so nothing forecast it. My inheritance is g22_anchor.json (close 3.198, chain-verified against g21_actual's last day) plus tape_conditions. I hold NO chain polarity, NO chain age and NO cum_from_anchor across the group boundary, so every cum-keyed and chain-keyed instrument stands down by absence, not by judgement. k=0 from the anchor, so boundary.chain_staleness_gate would license a cum-keyed rung if I had one; I do not. Per the anchor's own direction_caveat I do NOT use anchor_lasthr_dir (-1 on a 2-tick net, 18 pct of a $110 last-hour range = the price resolution floor); I use close_in_range 0.273 and, per the G21 declined_evidence lesson recorded against me in magnitude.block_gap_ownership, I do NOT promote that 60-minute object to a session-close-location or a phase-absorption verdict. It is corroboration only.

WHAT THE THIN HOLIDAY FRIDAY DOES AND DOES NOT GIVE ME. tape_conditions.prior_full_session for 0619 is labelled 'the last FULL session' and that label is FALSE here: 6,935 trades / 12,148 lots against a ~35,000-trade median, roughly one fifth of normal participation. What I CAN take from it, because it is a ratio and not a level: the D-1 trade tilt is SELL and it is unambiguous - session_signed_flow -1,353, session_b_share_two_sided 0.433 (below the 0.50 bar, and the two-sided series is the only one on which an ABSOLUTE 0.50 bar is meaningful per the b_share_basis_note), phase_signed_flow [-132, -90, -1131] with sell ACCELERATING, and l1_book quote_bid_share 0.464 (resting liquidity leaning offer). Cross-check that the tilt is DELIVERED rather than ABSORBED: vol_regime serves n0_prev_net -80 on n0_prev_range 620 for that session, so sign(session flow) x sign(day price) is ALIGNED. structure.covering_absorption_directional_tell limb (c) - flow aligned with price = genuine delivery, the flow direction wins - is the limb that fires; limb (a) (sell ABSORBED under a rising/holding price = covering discharge UP) does NOT fire, because price did not rise or hold: the day was -80 and the last hour closed at 0.273 of its range. Absorption is the ONLY named mechanism that would turn this crowded-short backdrop UP, and it is absent.

WHAT I CANNOT TAKE. I cannot take a MAGNITUDE or an exhaustion/turn verdict from 0619. Its phase_volume_lots are [1003, 1791, 9354]: ph3 carried 77 pct of session volume, against ~52 pct in the G20 full-session exemplar recorded under daytype.friday_exit_close_location_over_flow_shape. On a holiday half-session with phases that are SESSION-RELATIVE and not clock-anchored (BRIEF), the most likely mechanical cause of that concentration is that the session's business was compressed late, not that the close was distributed. I therefore claim ONLY 'the sell tilt is established on the session's one well-participated phase' and explicitly do NOT claim a distribution-into-the-close mechanism, which the state cannot discriminate from late-session compression. Also unavailable: n0_range_pctile 18.3 is measured ON that partial session and is not evidence of a quiet regime - n0_range_5_mean 1134 and n0_range_10_mean 1126 say the trailing range regime is normal.

TWO STAND-DOWNS THAT CARRY INFORMATION. (i) flow.passive_ladder_displacement needs BOTH (a) final-phase |net| below ~5 pct of the prior phase AND (b) final-phase volume at the session max. Limb (b) holds (9,354 = session max); limb (a) fails by three orders of magnitude (-1,131 against ph2's -90). This close is the OPPOSITE configuration to a passive-ladder cancellation - one-sided sell at maximum volume - which strengthens the aligned-delivery read rather than merely failing to contradict it. (ii) boundary.prior_close_flow_direction_disagreement is UNEVALUABLE at its own stated grain: the anchor serves last_hour.signed_flow null BY DESIGN (downsampled series). At the grains I do hold (ph3 flow -1,131, last-hour price -20) there is no disagreement, i.e. 'aligned close, carry as normal', but I record that as a grain-mismatched proxy, not as the play firing.

GAP OWNERSHIP - magnitude.block_gap_ownership in strict order. This is a WEEKEND/HOLIDAY-spanning boundary, so the |gap|<=10 intra-week regularity (24/24, measured by me in the G21 refine) does not apply. (1) ANCHOR_STRUCTURAL - DECLINED on three named limbs. No live squeeze: squeeze_watch active is UNKNOWN not false (frozen vintage, live dte 4 on NGN26, spread limb masked), but the gate needs calendar_front_next_spread_chg_3d > 0 and the last decision-legit reading is -0.021 (spread going MORE contango, -0.043), while cash_basis is -0.139 and COLLAPSING (chg_3d -0.212, chg_5d -0.179) - the physical is loose, the exact inverse of the G12 squeeze signature (+10.77, chg_3d +7.29). No dead sponsor: last_prompt_symbol NGM26 expired 2026-05-27, sessions_since_prompt_expiry 16 against the rule's ~3, unwind_watch false. (NGN26's 06-26 expiry is inside this block but is ahead of me, not behind me; it is 0629's structural condition, not mine.) No armed parabolic crest: no chain state, and the vol regime is n0_net_sigma_5 589 with no extension to crest. (1.5) POSITIONING_SATURATION_TURN - DECLINED on three of four limbs: (a) needs BOTH books at 1y short extremes; NYMEX MM 2.83 pctile passes but ICE LD1 is 6.6 against the ~3 bar and is net LONG +382,649, so (a) fails; (c) fails - consensus is a +74 Bcf INJECTION against a +114 vs-5yr surplus, nothing erasing arithmetically; (d) fails outright - the turn window requires storage phase WITHDRAW and the phase is INJECT. (2) WEEKEND_CYCLE_WEATHER - VOID BY INSTRUMENT, and this is the honest hole. The only forward ladder served is HDD (horizons, run_delta, fwd7 span) in a July block, and every value sits at 0.067-0.301 absolute gw-HDD against the s102.1 warm_cut_headroom_gate's ~13.5 floor, so the ladder carries no Bcf content in either direction and NEAR-SUM cannot be computed in its own instrument. No forward CDD ladder exists (auditor-declared). The single live CDD datum is forecast_run_delta_cdd +1.053 at D0 only, with model_disagreement h0 spread_gw_cdd +1.099 (MAV hotter than MET) - a mildly hotter D0 revision with zero forward mass, which under the NEAR-SUM ladder is the PRICED arm boundary at best. I do NOT convert a CDD number into an HDD-calibrated band; that constant does not exist in the brain. (3) CHAIN_DRIFT - NOT EVALUABLE. Its trigger is 'prior close AT its chain-side extreme', which needs a session close-off-low and a declared chain sign. I hold neither: no inherited chain across the group boundary, and the only close-location field I have is the 60-minute one I am forbidden to promote.

SO NO RUNG OWNS THIS GAP, and I say so rather than forcing one. What I size it on instead is the gap-FORMING session itself, which is a direct non-price measurement: the Sunday 0621 reopen traded 191 trades / 252 lots with session_signed_flow +16 - roughly a tenth of the G20 reopen stub referenced in the brain (2,620 lots, +278). A weekend that traded nothing repriced nothing. That derivation puts the gap BELOW weekend_gap_delivery's 'already-priced' +200..+400 floor rather than inside it, and it is a derivation (participation of the forming session), not a fit. Sign: the stub's own two-sided b_share is 0.549 with phase shape [0.429 sell on 139 lots, 0.700 buy on 96, dead on 17] and the D0 CDD revision is hotter, so the mild lean is UP. Gap = +20, declared near-noise and explicitly NOT load-bearing on the day.

DIRECTION. monday.catchup_window_tilt_gate FIRES: direction = the inherited D-1 (Friday+Sunday) trade tilt, not the gap sign and not the Friday day-net. That tilt is SELL on 12,148 lots against a +16 stub on 252 - the Friday dominates by ~48x on volume and the stub note forbids treating that sample as a tilt. Its fade arm needs a driver that REALIZED over the weekend; there was no driver at all, so there is nothing to sell the news of and the carry stands. monday.overnight_headfake_into_catchup FIRES: the reopen leans price-up on essentially zero net flow (+16) against a sell D-1 tilt, which is its NON-CONFIRMING configuration - do not inherit the overnight sign; the 06-10 ET catch-up window is where the tilt reasserts. This is the play that gives the path its shape (small up gap, reversed through the catch-up window) and it is a direction gate that sizes nothing. Corroborating fundamentals, all bearish and all open-time: storage 2,759 Bcf at +114 vs 5yr with a +73 injection and phase INJECT; curve contango with curve_slope_1 +0.043; cash basis -0.139 and deteriorating on 1d/3d/5d. Corroborating on the other side, honestly: nuclear_outages 3.375 GW out and rising (+1,210 MW /7d, gas-for-GW at the margin) and grid_stack US48 demand 11.89M MWh against an 11.61M forecast - mildly supportive, but 2 days stale, weekend data, and no brain play reads grid_stack directionally, so I carry them as context and NOT as a generator.

THE CROWDED SHORT, HANDLED FALSIFIABLY. COT MM net -122,617 at the 2.83rd 1y / 6.05th 3y percentile and WORSENING (WoW -7,763). positioning.covering_self_limiting_cot_wow_gate is explicit that worsening WoW = covering LIVE and RECURRING, size full, re-fires at the next seam - AND equally explicit on scope: 'this gate governs the TAIL and the SIZE, never the p50 SIGN (an extreme+worsening short can sit under a p50-DOWN day)'. I therefore make NO spent/self-limiting claim (I could not clear its limb (b) anyway, since WoW is worsening not flat), and I carry the crowded short as a declared FAT UPPER TAIL: an absorption-triggered covering ignition is the single named way this day goes materially up, and the trigger (sell absorbed under holding price) is absent at the exit I inherit. I reach DOWN from the delivered D-1 tilt and the bearish fundamental stack, NOT from 'the short is unfired' - which is precisely the non-falsifiable-toward-DOWN construction the S106 post-mortem struck.

MAGNITUDE, DERIVED. Regime scale: n0_net_sigma_5 589, sigma_10 614, sigma_20 868, n0_activity_trend +0.202 (participation building); v0 basis entirely null so every band is n0-only, declared. Two priors pull opposite ways and I resolve them rather than averaging: daytype.monday_weekend_gap says Monday is a big mover, size UP; its own exception clause says a Monday with NO active weather catalyst is quiet, size DOWN - and 'no active catalyst' is exactly what this state reads (HDD void, CDD flat, no shot, no print until Thursday, days_to_next_eia 3). The nearest MEASURED analogue band is magnitude.s1void_injection_chain_bleed's TREND arm, -450..-780, whose fundamental preconditions all hold here (storage phase inject, loose/building surplus, near-window HDD normals far below ~20, sub-0.50 two-sided sell tape, seasonal amplifier absent) but whose SEASON scope (S1-void spring) and CHAIN precondition (a running down-chain) do not - I have no chain to be 'chain-sided' with. I therefore do NOT fire it; I use its band as a cross-check only and take a number just BELOW its shallow edge, because the chain precondition is unverified, the D-1 evidence comes off one fifth of a normal tape, and the upper tail is live. -420 is 0.71 x n0_net_sigma_5 and sits at -0.34 x the trailing range mean. SHAPE: grind, not spike - daytype.monday_weekend_gap's grind form is the read when the reopen is dead and there is no catalyst to front-load, so the curve is a monotone bleed with the largest single leg in the 06-10 catch-up window (-190 of -440 by 10:00, ~43 pct) per my lens, and the remainder distributed across midday and the afternoon.

EXPIRY-WEEK CONTEXT, DECLARED AND NOT BANKED. days_to_futures_expiry 4 (NGN26, 06-26), days_to_opex 3 (06-25, same day as the EIA print). I own the Aug leg (ng_mbo_ngq26), which is the DEFERRED contract this week; contract_structure shows open_interest_next_chg_1d +19,845 into NGQ26 against +4,287 in NGU26, i.e. the roll is building into my leg, which is mechanically a mild bid. NO brain play covers a commercial roll-in bid on a deferred leg, and flow.resting_program_inverts_aggressor_tilt does not reach it (its trigger is in_bcom_roll/in_gsci_roll, both FALSE at business_day_of_month 15 - the monthly flags are true but both roll windows have passed). I record the OI build as an observation and deliberately do NOT bank a mechanism on it; it is part of why I trim the magnitude toward the shallow edge rather than a reason to change sign.

days.reasoning: DIRECTION UP, and the GAP owns essentially all of it. (1) E's OWN NAMED FLIP CONDITION FIRED. E emitted monday_bias DOWN-SMALL and wrote that the one thing that flips it is a weekend heat ADD. model_disagreement asof 2026-06-28T23:59Z, 16/16 metros, coverage 1.0, both models: mav_gw_cdd 10.076 -> 14.815 (+4.74), met_gw_cdd 9.441 -> 13.612 (+4.17); D+1 is hotter still (mav 10.548 -> 15.933, met 8.632 -> 13.935). The largest single-session CDD step anywhere else in my slice is +2.21 (0623->0624). weather_forecast.forecast_gw_cdd carries the same 14.815 and weather.gw_cdd the same 14.8 - though these are all the MAV run, so MET is the one genuinely independent corroboration. Per _information_clock the MET Sunday 12Z cycle posts ~15:30-16:30 ET, BEFORE the 18:00 ET reopen, so the reopen prices +4.17 at minimum; the MAV 18Z posts ~21:30-22:30 ET, after the reopen but well before my 08:00 open, so it lands inside the same gap window and ACCELERATES it. Two consecutive hot cycles = magnitude.weekend_gap_delivery's fresh/accelerating arm on the letter, not the already-priced arm. Forecast-model derived, so immune to the nws_temp partial-fetch tail defect. (2) GAP OWNERSHIP, magnitude.block_gap_ownership strict order, each rung tested against a measured quantity. Rung 1 ANCHOR_STRUCTURAL: the dead-sponsor CALENDAR trigger is live (squeeze_watch unwind_watch true, sessions_since_prompt_expiry 1, NGN26 expired 0626 confirmed by flow_calendar is_expiry_day true) but the arm requires premium STRANDED IN THE FRONT and the front was at a DISCOUNT - contract_structure calendar_front_settle 3.233 vs calendar_next_settle 3.276, calendar_front_next_spread -0.043 cheapening (chg_3d -0.021), curve_regime contango on every day of the block, squeeze_watch days_to_calendar_front_expiry_live 21. DECLINE. (Caveat: that spread is the frozen 0619 vintage and frozen_structure_stale says front-keyed fields are not decision-legit; the decline therefore rests on the contango regime plus the absence of any evidence in-slice that the front ever carried premium, not on the stale number alone.) Rung 1b positioning_saturation_turn: limb (a) fails (NYMEX MM 1y pctile 29.25, needs <=~12) and limb (d) fails (storage phase inject, needs withdraw). DECLINE. Rung 2 WEEKEND_CYCLE_WEATHER OWNS IT, fresh arm. chain_drift never reached. (3) GAP SIZE, derived not fitted. The fresh arm's +1500..+2500 is winter-measured; vol_regime n0_net_sigma_10 = 614 and n0_range_pctile 18.3 make that 2.4-4.1 sigma, implausible. Two independent derivations: FUNDAMENTAL - +4.7 gw_cdd is roughly +4-5 Bcf/d of incremental power burn while it holds, and h1 > h0 says it holds at least into D+1, so ~20-28 Bcf of balance improvement against a storage vs_5yr surplus of +112 and a loose 81 Bcf consensus three days out; that dents but does not erase the cushion, worth ~2-5 cents = +200..+500. VOL-SCALED - the fresh-shot arm rescaled by regime sigma lands higher, +700..+1200. daytype.thin_session_range_invariance argues against under-sizing a 194-trade reopen (price per unit of flow rises as participation falls, so excursions survive), and daytype.monday_weekend_gap's honest record is that fresh-shot Monday gaps are UNDER-forecast 3 for 3 (1020, 0118, 0125) - all winter, all in higher-sigma regimes. Offsets: nuclear_outages chg_1d -940.7 MW and chg_7d -1443.1 MW (capacity RETURNING, bearish burn at the margin), and cot.ice.ld1 managed_money_net_chg_wow -21,905 at the 2.83rd 1y pctile, a third consecutive week of liquidation (-16,542, -30,467, -21,905). Settled at +480, about 0.78 sigma and 43% of n0_range_10_mean 1126. Band +200..+850. (4) THE SESSION GIVES A LITTLE BACK. selector.divergence_resolution's trigger is exactly satisfied - a storage/S3-bearish DOWN angle against a weather-add UP angle inside a confirmed S1-void injection regime (near-window normals base ~0.2 gw HDD, well under 20; storage phase inject; consensus 81 Bcf building on a +112 surplus). Its gate (a), near-window max forecast gw-HDD vs 16.4, is INAPPLICABLE not failed: the ladders are HDD-only in a block whose driver runs CDD 7.8 -> 18.9, and reading its unreachability as a bearish verdict is the artifact the auditor named. Its gate (b), session_b_share >= ~0.50, is the play's own declared physical-neutrality bar, so per the b_share_basis_note it must be read TWO-SIDED: 0626 = 0.504 and the 0628 stub = 0.521, both clear (on the biased original series they read 0.472 and 0.424 and would fail - the exact S108 trap). With gate (a) unevaluable and gate (b) marginal, the play's own conclusion is that the add owns AT MOST the single reopen gap it enters on and earns NO intraday day-lean, with the session net reverting to the S3 bleed. That is an independent arrival at the same split. monday.catchup_window_tilt_gate's 0406 precedent says the same thing in its own words: a sub-threshold shoulder add prices ONCE in the reopen gap and then the tape reasserts. Sized at -155, roughly a third of the gap. (5) THE SESSION IS NOT DEEPLY NEGATIVE, for two reasons. weekend.carry_realization_flip: the driver's peak is still AHEAD of Monday (h1 CDD 15.933 > h0 14.815), so Monday CARRIES rather than sells the news - this is not a realization fade. And monday.overnight_headfake_into_catchup does NOT fire: the 0628 stub's flow CONFIRMS an up gap (session_signed_flow +13, two-sided 0.521, phase two-sided 0.513/0.529/0.600 rising into the close), and the play's own caveat says that on a Monday whose overnight gap confirms the D-1 tilt the gap is real and it stands down. So the 08-10 catch-up window ratifies rather than reverses; the fade is the S3-bearish complex reasserting later, not a head-fake unwinding. (6) THE 0626 BIG-PRINT FLIP IS ROLL MECHANICS AND I VERIFY IT INDEPENDENTLY OF A. flow_calendar.is_expiry_day is TRUE on 0626 - NGN26's expiry day - and the scored leg is the deferred NGQ26, so every roll and every expiring-long transfer prints as an aggressor BUY on the leg being measured. Three price-free confirmations. (i) THE DISPOSITIVE ONE: session_signed_flow FELL from +1,956 on 0625 to +871 on 0626 on the day big_print_b_share supposedly flipped from 0.499 to 0.783. Less aggregate net buying on the day the blocks turned buy. Decomposing, at any plausible big-print size threshold (210 prints) the block cohort alone contributes several thousand lots of net buy, which forces the residual non-block tape to be a clear net SELLER on Friday - I state that sign as robust and decline to claim its magnitude, since the big-print size threshold is not served. (ii) session_b_share_two_sided did not move (0.509 -> 0.504, marginally lower). (iii) unsided_volume_frac collapsed 0.133 -> 0.063, which is what a large sided-block cohort does mechanically. Also consistent: n_trades FELL 51,708 -> 48,072 while volume_lots ROSE 119,374 -> 121,487 (average print size up) and leg_count_150 was flat 38 -> 37 while big_prints_n nearly doubled 122 -> 210. So flow.price_free_absorption_proxy's precondition is met on the letter (positive session flow, 210 prints, guard-clean) and its accumulation-confirmed reading would be BULLISH - I stand it down anyway as contaminated, because the input it reads is a mechanical roll rather than a directional decision.
